tuning_key.text: What we see are branches of a tree / Part of a wisdom bigger than you and me
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The valley is already occupied. Connection is not something you add — it is the larger life you were already inside of, even in the shadowed stretch.

practice.title: Unclench
practice.instruction: Let one slow exhale loosen whatever you are holding — wheel, keys, the set of your jaw — without trying to fix anything.

practice.title: Shared Ground
practice.instruction: Sense the air and the ground as already shared; other lives occupy this same stretch, and nothing here asks you to walk it alone.

practice.title: Receive
practice.instruction: Press play and let the Echo arrive at the pace of your breath — open, warm, nothing to force.
